question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Denizen
solution:
The correct answer is: **Habitat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Denizen"** refers to an inhabitant or occupant of a particular place. (निवासी)

 
 
• **Example: **He is a **denizen **of the forest, knowing every tree and trail.
 
 
 
• **"Habitat"** means the natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism. (आवास)
 
 
• **Example: **The polar bear's natural **habitat** is the Arctic region.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Habitat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exile** (निर्वासन): The state of being barred from one's native country, typically for political or punitive reasons.

 
 
• **Example:** He lived in exile for many years after the revolution.
 
 
 
• **Visitor** (आगंतुक): A person visiting a place for a short time.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum was full of visitors from all over the world.
 
 
 
• **Transient** (अस्थायी): Lasting only for a short time; impermanent.
 
 
• **Example:** The transient beauty of the sunset left everyone in awe.
 
 

31:Tc12,

The correct answer is: Option 3.&
